cases.name: M1 启动 → 首页渲染（本地栈）
cases.steps: automator connect ws://127.0.0.1:9421 → 等首页渲染 → 断言页面路径+根节点 → login 页点「获取验证码」走真实 sms/send → 直查 Redis → 截图
cases.expected: 页面 ∈ {coach,login,onboarding} 且根节点渲染；UI 触发的 /api/auth/sms/send 在本地栈 Redis 落 sms:code:<phone>:bind_phone；零生产域名
cases.evidence: harness/miniprogram/test-results/m1-failure.png；console 尾部: [auth] 请求验证码 scene=bind_phone phone=13988282484 ⏎ [http] → POST http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/auth/sms/send {"phone":"13988282484","scene":"bind_phone"} ⏎ [login] 验证码发送失败，展示给用户的文案： 操作失败，请重试 ⏎ [http] ✗ POST http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/auth/sms/send {"errMsg":"request:fail url not in domain list"} ⏎ [auth] 非 ApiError 的失败: {"errMsg":"request:fail url not in domain list"}
cases.error: 点「获取验证码」后 Redis 未见 sms:code:13988282484:bind_phone — 小程序↔本地栈链路没打通
